run_onedocker_package: run a OneDocker package executable in a container with specified version and arguments
download_executable_from_s3: download a OneDocker package executable from an S3 repository to a local path
run_opawdl_workflow: run a pre-defined OPAWDL workflow using the OneDocker Plugin Architecture driver
prepare_executable_with_permissions: prepare and set execute permissions on a downloaded OneDocker package executable
generate_tls_certificate: generate a TLS certificate for a OneDocker package using a CertificateRequest
